library_path.description: Path to the TinyFugue standard library file.

options.visual_mode.description: Enable visual mode (split screen for input/output).

options.wrap_output.description: Enable automatic line wrapping for MUD output.

worlds.items.description: Configuration for a single MUD world.

worlds.items.name.description: The name of the world used for switching and identification.

worlds.items.host.description: The hostname or IP address of the MUD server.

worlds.items.port.description: The port number of the MUD server.

worlds.items.type.description: The server type (e.g., 'lp', 'diku'). Determines prompt handling.

worlds.items.triggers.description: List of trigger/hilit definitions for the world.

worlds.items.macros.description: List of macro definitions for the world.

worlds.items.macros.items.body.description: The TinyTalk code body of the macro.

worlds.items.keybinds.description: List of key bindings for the world.

worlds.items.keybinds.items.key.description: Key sequence to bind (e.g., ^P for Ctrl-P).

worlds.items.keybinds.items.command.description: Command to execute when key is pressed.

worlds.items.autologin.enabled.description: Enable automatic login for this world.
